data.content:
* * *

## [Fantastic Customer Service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a68166cf5098a29baf7e0cf)
Fantastic Customer Service! As a designer I work frequently with several furnishing companies. I've had some bad experiences, and this was NOT one of them..The representative, Dorema M., from Lulu and Georgia provided constant communication and very helpful in working out a "sample" for a rug that did not have one available. The Rug we purchased is lovely - great quality piece. Great Job Dorema and Lulu and Georgia. I will source here more!

July 15, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 28, 2026

Tucker,

We are so happy to hear about your positive experience with us! It's wonderful that our team could assist you in finding the perfect rug, especially by arranging a sample when one wasn't readily available. We truly appreciate your kind words about the quality of our products and the service you received. We look forward to helping you with your future sourcing needs.

Lulu and Georgia
